many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def comps_of(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for yy in range(H):
        for xx in range(W):
            c=g[yy][xx]
            if seen[yy][xx]: continue
            q=deque([(yy,xx)]); seen[yy][xx]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
            out.append(cells)
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    ch={(y,x):(gi[y][x],go[y][x]) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y][x]!=go[y][x]}
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    C=comps_of(gi)
    feats=[]
    for c in C:
        sy=min(y for y,_ in c); sx=min(x for _,x in c)
        hy=max(y for y,_ in c); hx=max(x for _,x in c)
        h_,w_=hy-sy+1,hx-sx+1
        norm=tuple(sorted((y-sy,x-sx) for y,x in c))
        # duplicate count: same norm+size, any color
        ndup=sum(1 for o in C if o!=c and tuple(sorted((y-min(yy for yy,_ in o),min(xx for _,xx in o)) for yy,xx in o))==norm and len(o)==len(c))
        # touching grid edge?
        te = any(y==sy or x==sx or y==hy-1 or x==hx-1 for y,x in c)
        # is rect solid?
        solid = len(c)==h_*w_
        feats.append((c,sy,sx,hy,hx,h_,w_,norm,len(c),ndup,te,solid,g[0][0]))
    res=[]
    for c,sy,sx,hy,hx,h_,w_,norm,n,ndup,te,solid,bg in feats:
        isch = any(ch.get(p) for p in c)
        res.append((isch, sy,sx, hy-hy+1, w_, norm, n, ndup, te, solid))
    for isc,*f in sorted(res,key=lambda f:(f[1],f[2])):
        mark='*' if isc else ' '
        print(mark,f"{f[1]:2},{f[2]:2} col={gi[f[1]][f[2]]} sz={f[8]:2} ndup={f[7]:2} te={f[9]} solid={f[10]}")

from collections import Counter,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def comps_of(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] and seen[r][c] is None:
                col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=1; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=1; stack.append((x,y))
                rs=[p for p in cells]; cs_=[q for q in cells]
                mr=max(p[0] for p in rs)-min(p[0] for p in rs)+1
                mc=max(q[0] for q in cs_)-min(q[0] for q in cs_)+1
                norm=tuple(tuple(g[p[0]-mr+i][q[0]-mc+j] for j in range(mc)) for i in range(mr))
                out.append({'col':col,'size':len(cells),'shape':norm,'pos':(cells[0],) if False else min(cells)})
                # bounding box center
                rr=min(p[0] for p in rs); cc2=min(q[0] for q in cs_)

                touch = any(a==0 or b==0 or p[0]+mr-1==h-1 or b+mc-1==w-1 for a,b in cells)

def comps(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); seen=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and seen[i][j] is None:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=1; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=1; stack.append((x,y))
                rr=min(p[0] for p in cells); cc=min(p[1] for p in cells)
                mask=tuple(tuple(g[rr+i][cc+j]==col for j in range(max(p[1] for p in cells)-cc+1)) for i in range(max(p[0] for p in cells)-rr+1))
                out.append({'col':col,'size':len(cells),'mask':mask,'tl':(rr,cc),'cells':sorted(cells)})
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); seen=[[None]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and seen[i][j] is None:
                col=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=1; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==col:
                            seen[x][y]=1; stack.append((x,y))
                rr=min(p[0] for p in cells); cc=min(p[1] for p in cells)
                mr=max(p[0] for p in cells)-rr+1; mc=max(p[1] for p in cells)-cc+1
                mask=tuple(tuple(1 if g[rr+i][cc+j]==col else 0 for j in range(mc)) for i in range(mr))
                out.append({'col':col,'size':len(cells),'mask':mask,'tl':(rr,cc),'cells':sorted(cells)})
    return out

# rule hypothesis: find duplicate-shape pairs; recolor one of them to the color of another comp? Check each demo
for n in sorted(G):

    base=n.replace(' input','').replace(' output','')
    gi=G[n]; go=G[n.replace('input','output')]
    cs=comps(gi); diffs={(i,j):go[i][j] for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]}
    # find duplicate mask groups

    bym=defaultdict(list)
    for c in cs: bym[c['mask']].append(c)
    dup_groups=[g for g in bym.values() if len(g)>1 and all(x['size']==g[0]['size'] for x in g)]
    print('=== %s'%(base))
    for g in dup_groups:
        cols=set(c['col'] for c in g)

        print('  dup group masks:',[c['mask'] for c in g],'cols:',cols,'changed->',targets)
        break
    uniq=[c for c in cs if (c['mask'],c['col']) in [(x['mask'],x['col']) for x in cs]

    # simpler: count (mask,col) pairs

# Hypothesis: target color = the unique/singleton color; source = component closest to that singleton comp. Verify.
def solve(n):
    gi=G['Demo pair %d input'%n]; go=G['Demo pair %d output'%n]
    cnt=Counter(c for row in gi for c in row)
    sing=[c for c in cnt if cnt[c]==1]
    singcnt=len(sing)
    cc=comps(gi)
    diff={(a,b) for a in range(len(gi)) for b in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[a][b]!=go[a][b]}
    src=[s for s,_ in cc if s&diff]
    tgt=set({gi[a][b] for a,b in diff})
    print('demo',n,'singleton colors:',sing,'src color:',[(len(s),col) for s,col in cc if s&diff][:1],'tgt:',tgt)
    si=list(src)[0]
    # distance to each singleton-color comp
    dlist=[]
    for s,c in cc:
        if c not in sing: continue
        d=min(abs(a-x)+abs(b-y) for a,b in si for x,y in s)
        dlist.append((d,c,len(s)))
    dlist.sort()
    print('  singleton comps by dist from src:',dlist[:4])

for n in range(1,9): solve(n)
